name: aha-meet
description: Real-time meeting-style collaboration with Claude Code

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:renderer && npm run typecheck:electron
scripts.build:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && cp electron/preload.cjs dist-electron/preload.cjs && cp electron/preload-editor.cjs dist-electron/preload-editor.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.test: npm run build:electron && node --import "data:text/javascript,import { register } from 'node:module'; import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'; register('./tests/electron-stub.mjs', pathToFileURL('./'));" --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.prebuild:speaker: node scripts/fetch-speaker-model.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run prebuild:whisper && npm run prebuild:speaker && npm run prebuild:claude-defaults && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 && node scripts/verify-macos-signing.mjs
scripts.dist:dmg: npm run prebuild:whisper && npm run prebuild:speaker && npm run prebuild:claude-defaults && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/verify-macos-signing.mjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run prebuild:whisper && npm run prebuild:speaker && npm run prebuild:claude-defaults && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prebuild:whisper && npm run prebuild:speaker && npm run prebuild:claude-defaults && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:dmg && npm run dist:win && npm run dist:linux
